name: rightly-compliance-assistant-pro
description: Professional edition of an AI-powered mobile app privacy compliance expert team for policy interpretation, violation analysis and remediation guidance

displayDescription.en: Professional privacy compliance team: interpret policies and notices, analyze violation details and use Rightly platform data to deliver actionable remediation plans.
displayDescription.zh: 隐私合规专家团，解读政策与通报条目，分析违规详情，结合专业版 Rightly 数据输出整改方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 某条目（如：违规收集个人信息）通常是由于 APP 什么行为、什么模块触发的
defaultInitPrompt.en: Which app behaviors and modules typically trigger a given violation (e.g. illegal collection of personal info)?

quickPrompts.en: Which app behaviors and modules typically trigger a given violation (e.g. illegal collection of personal info)?
quickPrompts.zh: 某条目（如：违规收集个人信息）通常是由于 APP 什么行为、什么模块触发的

quickPrompts.en: Analyze this compliance violation stack trace and give a solution
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我分析这个合规违规的调用堆栈，给出解决方案

quickPrompts.en: Check the Rightly platform compliance data for my product (productId=appid) and analyze the risks
